body:
## What this rental listing is

GetRentacar's Spain marketplace (`https://getrentacar.com/en-US/spain`) connects travelers with local car owners and regional rental fleets across mainland Spain and the islands. When inspected on 29 October 2026, the listing displayed **97 cars available for rent in Spain**, covering major pickup points including **Barcelona, Madrid, Valencia, Palma, Alicante, Marbella, and Ibiza**.

## Verified vehicles and daily rates on the page

While the category filters list Sedan, Coupe, SUV, and Minivan classes from US$ 25–30 per day, the specific vehicle cards displayed on the Spain page on 29 October 2026 included:

- **Fiat 500 (2005 & 2007 models, listings `#5049437` and `#5046860`):** Listed at **US$ 40 per day** with **Unlimited mileage** and GetRentacar's **Car guarantee**.
- **Fiat 500 (2020 model, listing `#5014103`):** Listed at **US$ 41 per day** with **Car guarantee**.
- **Citroen C3 Aircross (2020 model, listing `#5014124`):** Compact crossover listed at **US$ 93 per day** with **Car guarantee**.
- **BMW Z4 (2018 model, listing `#5044462`):** Convertible listed at **US$ 279 per day** with **No deposit**, **Unlimited mileage**, and **Car guarantee**.
- **Luxury & Supercar fleet:** The Spain catalog also lists high-end vehicles including the Ferrari California 2017 (US$ 1,079/day), Ferrari Portofino 2018 (US$ 1,350/day), and Porsche 911 2019 (US$ 1,564/day).

## Payment structure and driver rules

According to the Spain FAQ published on the page:

- **Debit cards accepted:** MasterCard and VISA debit cards are accepted. Travelers can pay **15% of the rental cost online** to lock in the reservation and pay the remaining **85% directly to the vehicle owner** at handover (or pay 100% online if enabled by the host).
- **Minimum driver age:** The minimum age to rent a car in Spain on the platform is **18 years old**, though drivers under 25 face higher rates.
- **Required documents:** A valid passport and a local or international driving licence (owners may also request a photo of the driver holding their licence).

## Important prepayment notice

The page's cancellation tooltip notes that the initial online prepayment covers GetRentacar's booking arrangement service and is non-refundable if the renter cancels, including if the renter fails to meet age or driving experience requirements. Always verify the individual vehicle's age, mileage, and deposit terms before submitting payment.
